tracks.name: kNN source-read 40-task original Table 1
tracks.split: Each of 40 LIBERO tasks 50 evaluation episodes; 2000 rollouts. Hyperparameter tuning used states 40-49, overlap with full eval.
tracks.protocol: Original source Table 1 author-reproduced baselines with same LIBERO 40/2000 interface, distinct checkpoints per model; not VLA-Radar reproduction.
tracks.trainingRegime: kNN ResNet & multimodal: no policy training; LAC key: learned linear projection; π0.5 used author's LeRobot checkpoint.

tracks.name: kNN author 420 fixed LIBERO-Plus variants
tracks.split: 420 selected variants total, 60 per each of 7 perturbation categories, over LIBERO 40 tasks; held out from tuning.
tracks.protocol: Original Table 1 420 fixed perturbation variants, not exhaustive official LIBERO-Plus variants or standard LIBERO control.
tracks.trainingRegime: Base LIBERO demonstrations for memory; kNN ResNet/multimodal frozen encoders; LAC linear projection trained; nine VLA checkpoints as released.

tracks.name: kNN multimodal retrieval ablations Table 3
tracks.split: 40-task 2000 episode author evaluation of multimodal kNN component variants.
tracks.protocol: Original Table 3: fixed multimodal retriever with one factor ablated; visual-language and demonstration memory effects, not a separate trained VLA leaderboard.
tracks.trainingRegime: Base ImageNet ResNet-18 and CLIP features frozen; different memory budgets and retrieval input; hyperparams from Optuna.
